Package com.egradx.webservice.exception.handler

Class EgradxWebServiceExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.core.web.EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport
com.egradx.webservice.exception.handler.EgradxWebServiceExceptionHandler
@Order(2147483647) @RestControllerAdvice public class EgradxWebServiceExceptionHandler extends EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport
The application's own error handling: every controller of an application on egradx-webservice answers its failures in the envelope the libraries use (contracts/schemas/error.json), by the same rules. The core exceptions and Spring's request errors are answered by EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport, Spring MVC's own HTTP errors with their status; anything else is a 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, logged, with a message that reveals nothing.

Ordered last, so a library's scoped handler, or an application's own advice for its own exceptions, answers first. To answer an exception of the application's own, add an advice for it (it can extend EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport and use respond).
